datalakeCrn.description: The CRN of the Data Lake where the Data Share will be created.

environmentCrn.description: The CRN of the Environment where the Data Share will be created.

dataShareName.description: The name of the Data Share to be created (Max length is 512 characters).

assets.description: List of assets to be included in the Data Share.

summary.description: A brief summary of the Data Share.

termsOfUse.description: The terms of use for the Data Share.

keywords.description: List of keywords associated with the Data Share.

expiryTime.description: The date and time when the Data Share will expire.

externalUsers.description: List of external users to be granted access to the Data Share.

AssetRequest.description: Details of an asset to be included in the Data Share.

databaseName.description: The name of the database containing the asset.

tableName.description: The name of the table containing the asset.

guid.description: The unique identifier of the asset (asset guid from the Atlas).

columns.description: List of columns in the asset (default all is included).

ExternalUserAccessUpdate.description: Specifies the updated access expiration time for an external user on a specific Data Share.

externalUserId.description: The unique identifier of the external user.

expiryTime.description: The date and time when the access of Data Share will expire for the external user.
